source.work: Vercel official documentation and explicitly selected project policy
source.paraphrase: A Vercel project must use at most one active file-based configuration format. A project can use the documented defaults without a configuration file.

invariants.why: A Vercel project must use at most one active file-based configuration format. A project can use the documented defaults without a configuration file.
invariants.fixHint: Bind VERCEL-001 to a human-reviewed product assertion with scope, applicability, owner, evidence source and freshness controls in its rationale. Include a failing control. Run pregate fitness run VERCEL-001; repair failed assertions. Review conditional applicability instead of returning an unexplained pass.
invariants.avoid: This is a project evidence gate, not a syntax detector or readiness certification. A receipt proves only the reviewed assertion ran on the current inputs. External legal, certification, deployment and performance evidence needs its own authenticity, scope and freshness checks inside that assertion. Missing evidence remains unverified. Pack fixtures test receipt admission, not the product requirement. Packs never supply executable commands.

source.paraphrase: The effective configuration must be valid for the selected framework and configuration format, and its production build and routing must match the reviewed settings.
